{{Infobox
| styles = {{{styles|classic}}}
| bodyclass = biography vcard
| above = <div class="fn" style="display:inline">{{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}}</div>
| image = {{#if:{{{image|}}}|[[File:{{{image}}}|frameless|upright=1.0|alt={{{alt|}}}]]}}
| caption = {{{caption|}}}
| label1 = Born
| data1 = {{#if:{{{birth_name|}}}|<div class="nickname">{{{birth_name}}}</div>}}{{{birth_date|}}}{{#if:{{{birth_place|}}}|<div class="birthplace">{{{birth_place}}}</div>}}
| label2 = Died
| data2 = {{{death_date|}}}{{#if:{{{death_place|}}}|<br />{{{death_place}}}}}
| label3 = Nationality
| data3 = {{{nationality|}}}
| label4 = Other names
| data4 = {{{other_names|}}}
| label5 = Occupation
| data5 = {{#if:{{{occupation|}}}|<div class="role">{{{occupation}}}</div>}}
| label6 = Years active
| data6 = {{{years_active|}}}
| label7 = Employer
| data7 = {{{employer|}}}
| label8 = Known&nbsp;for
| data8 = {{{known_for|}}}
| label9 = Notable work
| data9 = {{{notable_works|}}}
| label10 = Height
| data10 = {{{height|}}}
| label11 = Spouse
| data11 = {{{spouse|}}}
| label12 = Children
| data12 = {{{children|}}}
| header13 = {{#if:{{{website|}}}{{{signature|}}}|Online presence}}
| label14 = Website
| data14 = {{{website|}}}
| data15 = {{{footer|}}}
| below = {{{module|}}}
}}<noinclude>
Wikipedia-style person infobox (test fixture).
</noinclude>
